purpose: Run an isolated, one-candidate source-grounded Agent Form acceptance pilot. JSON Schema constrains evidence and finding references to the exact EV identifiers in the commit-pinned catalog. Model context is reduced to two verified source files / 3,500 characters and model output is capped at 700 tokens. This pilot validates purpose, six specialist roles, the positive source-linked evidence gate and independent review before any two-candidate/global scaling.
inference: Ollama on GitHub runner, CPU-only, bound to 127.0.0.1:11434
acceptance: restore and verify immutable source-capture checkpoint 43615137961 / artifact 14121666814
bootstrap a fresh SQLite mission database and unique r3 mission ID; do not reuse r1/r2 task states
complete one candidate-purpose output and six distinct source-grounded specialist reports
the evidence JSON Schema enum must exactly match evidence IDs from that candidate's pinned source inspection
finding evidence_refs must be enum-constrained to the same pinned catalog IDs
no model output may place raw source excerpts, line-numbered text or paths in the evidence array
complete one positive candidate-purpose and specialist evidence gate with task/report/commit/tree provenance
complete one adversarial independent review with an explicit review decision and disagreements/reservations
retain intermediate retry attempts but accept only terminal task failures as failures if a bounded retry later succeeds
verify all 8 semantic tasks are complete, with exactly 7 distinct prior purpose/specialist reports available to the reviewer
inspect full artifact, model manifest, retry log, task ledger and every specialist/reviewer report before accepting the candidate
do not increment the semantic audit count from task completion alone
do not start two-candidate or global semantic scaling from this pilot
model_runtime: Ollama loopback-only local CPU inference on GitHub-hosted runner
